PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L1":     (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "I1":     (14e-6, 8e-6, 18e-6),
    "Rf":     (300e3, 265e3, 420e3),
    "gmid_sf":(15.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "I2":     (8e-6, 4e-6, 12e-6),
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "Lp":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Lb":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1, I2, Rf = p["I1"], p["I2"], p["Rf"]
    Ib2 = 2e-6                                   # PMOS bias branch
    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15

    # --- input CS stage ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs
    vout_dc = vin_dc                              # no DC current in Rf
    # --- source follower ---
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], 0.5, I2, vds=max(0.4, 1.8 - vout_dc), vsb=vout_dc)
    vx = vout_dc + msf.vgs
    # --- PMOS load mirror ---
    mp1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(0.2, 1.8 - vx))
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Ib2, vds=mp1.vgs)
    # --- NMOS bias mirrors from ibias ---
    gmb = 12.0
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=mn0.vgs)
    mnsf = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], I2, vds=max(0.2, vout_dc))
    mnb = lut.size("n", gmb, p["Lb"], Ib2, vds=max(0.3, 1.8 - mp0.vgs))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MN0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp0)
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp1)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("MSF", "vdd", "x", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.dev("MNSF", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnsf)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)

    # --- analytic predictions ---
    gx = m1.gds + mp1.gds
    A0 = m1.gm / gx
    gsf = msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + mnsf.gds + 1.0 / Rf
    asf = msf.gm / gsf
    Cx = m1.cdd + mp1.cdd + 0.3 * msf.cgg + m1.cgd
    Co = cl + mnsf.cdd + 0.2 * msf.cgg
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    wa = gx / Cx
    wo = gsf / Co
    f = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    A = A0 * asf / ((1 + s / wa) * (1 + s / wo))
    Zf = Rf / (1 + s * Rf * m1.cgd)
    H = A * Zf / (1 + A + s * Zf * Cin)
    H0 = abs(H[0])
    idx = np.where(np.abs(H) < H0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = f[idx[0]] if len(idx) else f[-1]

    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    gamma = 0.8
    vn2 = kT4 * gamma * (m1.gm + mp1.gm) / m1.gm**2
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + vn2 * ((1.0 / Rf)**2 + (w1 * (Cin + m1.cgd))**2)

    power = 1.8 * (iref + Ib2 + I1 + I2)
    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(H0), "f3db": float(f3db), "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2)}
